## This week

The inference an agent consumes — calls × tokens × model tier — placed on the same axis as accuracy: the cost–accuracy trade, compute-optimal allocation, and the levers (routing, cascades, caching, budgets). Then agent-level benchmarks on top of W5's component evaluation: the AI-Agents-That-Matter critique, cost–accuracy Pareto curves, and consistency metrics (τ-bench, pass^k). The course eval harness that final presentations must defend against.

## Lab

Routing with cost logging + the course evaluation harness (published before class).

Run it in Colab: download the notebook, go to [colab.research.google.com](https://colab.research.google.com) → Upload, paste your API key into the setup cell ([API Setup](api-setup.qmd)), and run top to bottom.
